fields.original: 15秒电影感日料广告。深色木质料理台，左上方暖光，浅景深，舒缓纯音乐。0–3秒俯拍整条带冰三文鱼，白衣厨师扶住鱼头尾；3–7秒切极近微距，厨刀切入橙红鱼柳；7–12秒切近景，厨师给饭团覆鱼片、按压，用银镊点上绿叶；12–15秒切成品展示。 最后一镜中，成品在哑光黑盘正中，日文书法「一期一会、極上の味」从左到右写出，墨色渐浓，末笔落定微光定格。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, in an overhead high-angle shot, the camera pushes in at slow speed toward a whole, fresh salmon resting atop a bed of crushed glistening ice on a dark oiled wood counter. A middle-aged male chef wearing a crisp white cotton sushi uniform stands behind the counter, his bare hands carefully holding and stabilizing the fish by its silver-scaled head on the left and tapered tail on the right. Warm directional key light spills from the upper-left corner, highlighting melting water droplets and iridescent scales against the rich shadowed wood, creating a shallow depth of field. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to an extreme macro shot as the camera pans right at slow speed, tracking the blade of a polished single-bevel yanagiba knife slicing cleanly through a thick, vibrant orange-red salmon fillet on a dark wooden cutting board. The razor-sharp edge glides through the flesh at a low diagonal angle, parting the distinct white intramuscular fat striations with smooth precision, revealing glistening moisture across the cut surface under the warm upper-left rim light. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up from an eye-level angle holding a static shot of the chef's hands crafting a piece of nigiri. His deft fingers gently drape the sliced salmon fillet over an oval mound of vinegared sushi rice, executing a precise two-stroke press to mold the sushi firmly. He then lifts a pair of slender silver culinary tweezers and delicately sets a single fresh microgreen leaf onto the center of the fish, his hands moving with practiced rhythm against the out-of-focus dark wooden interior. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a close-up slightly high-angle shot as the camera pushes in at slow speed toward the finished salmon nigiri positioned squarely in the center of a circular matte black ceramic plate. Traditional Japanese calligraphy appears on screen, writing from left to right across the upper half of the frame in flowing sumi ink strokes to form "一期一会、極上の味", the ink density deepening from a soft wash to dense charcoal black, culminating in a subtle glint across the final brushstroke before settling into a pristine freeze-frame.
overall_soundscape: The delicate crunch and rustle of crushed ice shifting under the fish is clearly heard in the room tone, followed by the crisp, pronounced hiss and glide of the chef's knife parting the tender salmon fillet. Soft, audible finger presses against the moist rice grains accompany the assembly, punctuated by a distinct metallic click of tweezers setting the garnish. A muted, resonant ceramic tap concludes the sequence as the plate settles on the counter, accompanied by a quiet, warm interior kitchen ambience.
non_diegetic_music: A slow-tempo acoustic score featuring gentle solo piano chords intertwined with sustained, resonant koto plucks and a quiet, low-register cello pad underneath. The arrangement maintains a consistent, understated dynamic without crescendo, tapering to a sustained single note at the final rest.

整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影，在头顶高角度镜头中，摄影机以缓慢的速度向一整条新鲜的鲑鱼推进，这条鲑鱼躺在深色涂油木柜台上的碎冰床上。一位穿着整洁的白棉厨师服的中年男厨师站在柜台后面，空手小心翼翼地握住并稳定着左边银色鳞片的鱼头和右边锥形的鱼尾。温暖的定向主光从左上角溢出，突出了融化的水滴和虹彩鳞片与丰富的阴影木材的对比，创造了浅景深。 [镜头 2] 00:03.000，镜头以低速平移，切换到极端微距镜头，追踪抛光单刃柳刃包丁的刀刃，干净利落地切开深色木质切板上厚厚的、充满活力的橙红色鲑鱼片。锋利的边缘以低对角线滑过肉，以光滑的精度分开明显的白色肌肉内脂肪条纹，在温暖的左上边缘光下，在切割表面上显示出闪闪发光的水分。 [镜头 3] 00:07.000，镜头从与眼睛齐平的角度切换到中特写，拍摄了厨师双手制作手握寿司的静态镜头。他灵巧的手指轻轻地将切片三文鱼片放在椭圆形的醋寿司饭上，执行精确的两冲程按压，使寿司牢固成型。然后，他举起一把细长的银色烹饪镊子，小心地将一片新鲜的微绿叶子放在鱼的中心，双手以熟练的节奏在失焦的深色木质内部移动。 [镜头 4] 00:12.000，镜头切换到一个略高角度的特写镜头，镜头以慢速推向位于圆形哑光黑色陶瓷盘中央的成品三文鱼握寿司。传统的日本书法出现在屏幕上，从左到右，用流动的墨笔在画面的上半部分书写，形成"一期一会、極上の味"，墨水浓度从柔和的水洗加深到浓密的炭黑，最终在最后的笔触上出现微妙的闪烁，然后进入原始的定格画面。
整体声景：房间里清晰地听到碎冰在鱼下面移动时发出的微妙的嘎吱声和沙沙声，随后是厨师刀切开嫩鲑鱼片时发出的清脆、明显的嘶嘶声和滑动声。装配过程中，手指轻按潮湿的米粒，发出声音，中间夹杂着镊子设置装饰时发出的明显金属咔哒声。当盘子放在柜台上时，静音、回响的陶瓷轻叩声结束了整个序列，伴随着安静、温暖的室内厨房氛围。
非叙事音乐：慢速原声乐谱以柔和的钢琴独奏和弦与持续、共鸣的日本筝的拨弦声和安静的低音大提琴垫交织在一起。该编曲保持了一致、低调的动态，没有渐强，在最后的休息处逐渐减弱为持续的单音符。

fields.original: 女主播戴着深灰色头戴式耳机演示降噪。她按下配对键，听见提示音，轻触右耳罩。3.1 秒切到正面近景，她双手托着耳罩底部，摘下耳机举到镜头前，整条头梁都衬在浅色墙面上。耳机刚离开头发，头梁右端就与右耳罩断开，缝里能看见一指宽的浅墙。她举稳一秒，双手都没动，头梁末端却自己接回了右耳罩。全过程在同一近景里拍清楚。她指向充电口，轻快地说：“戴上就降噪，续航四十小时不断连。”

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, medium shot at a slight three-quarter angle as the camera executes a slow push in toward a young female on-screen live streamer in her twenties (S1), who has sleek shoulder-length black hair tucked behind her ears, wearing a soft cream-colored ribbed knit top and fitted matte dark gray over-ear noise-cancelling headphones. Centered before a modern studio background with a smooth, light beige wall and a softly blurred warm floating shelf, illuminated by a diffused softbox key light from the front-left, she raises her right hand to the outer rim of the right earcup. She presses the pairing button on the edge, tilts her head slightly upon hearing a prompt tone, and gently taps the flat exterior touch panel of the right earcup with her fingertip. [Shot 2] At 00:03.100, the camera cuts to a frontal close-up holding a static shot of the presenter (S1). She cradles the bottom of both earcups with her fingers, lifting the dark gray headphones upward and off her head to hold them steadily forward toward the lens, positioning the entire arched headband against the clean, light-colored wall surface. As the earpads clear her hair, the right end of the arch separates from its cup. In clear profile, a full finger-width of the pale wall is visible BETWEEN two distinct dark ends. Hold this open gap visibly for one full second. Then the headband end rejoins the right cup by itself while both hands remain motionless beneath the cups. Show joined, open gap, joined in the same uninterrupted close-up. Her hands support the bottom edges throughout; her fingers never cover the right hinge. Only after the hold, she points to the oval charging port and says cheerfully, <d>[Chinese] 戴上就降噪，续航四十小时不断连。</d>

non_diegetic_music: None.

整体声景：安静录音棚里，配对键的咔嗒声、同一电子提示音、轻微拿取声和清晰普通话台词。
非叙事音乐：无。

fields.original: 拍一条 9:16 写实竖屏广告。办公室午休，女生用右手揉肩，桌上的粉色筋膜枪放在咖啡杯旁。固定中景同时拍到她的肩、右手和筋膜枪。第 3 秒直接硬切。切前最后一帧，她空着的右手还搭在肩头，枪仍在咖啡杯旁。切后第一帧机位相同，她已经握着枪停在脸旁，杯旁的位置空了。她保持这个姿势半秒。她对镜头说：“你们久坐肩颈酸的时候，真的别硬扛。我以前一到下午，脖子就像被水泥糊住一样。”她开低档轻按肩颈，切到按摩头近景：“这个我喜欢的是它不重，女生单手拿也不累。下班前按个三五分钟，肩膀会松很多。”她靠回椅背调档，把枪放进抽屉，又拿出来晃一下：“经常久坐、低头、肩颈紧的，真的可以备一个。现在直播间有券，到手价很香。”

integrated_multimodal_description: A realistic vertical 9:16 office advert assembled from FOUR separately recorded takes. Same young woman with dark hair tied back and cream cardigan, same office during lunch, white coffee mug and pink massage device, tripod medium shot.
[Shot 1] 00:00.000–00:03.000. A still, held composition. She rubs her left shoulder with her EMPTY right hand and keeps that hand resting high on the shoulder through the VERY LAST FRAME. The pink massager lies untouched on the desk right beside the white cup in plain view for this entire shot. She stays several hand-widths away from it. Do not initiate any reach. Keep her hand, face, and the product on the table visible together.
[Shot 2] Start with a hard edit at 00:03.000. This take was recorded AFTER the product was picked up off camera. Match the tripod position exactly. In its very FIRST FRAME, the massager is ALREADY held vertically next to her cheek with her right hand, the empty tabletop next to the motionless mug clearly visible below. Begin this shot with half a second of COMPLETE STILLNESS in that pose. The jump is the edit itself: omit every frame in which the hand moves down, grasps anything or lifts it through space. In the same shot she addresses the camera: <d>[Chinese] 你们久坐肩颈酸的时候，真的别硬扛。我以前一到下午，脖子就像被水泥糊住一样。</d> She clicks the low setting and lightly touches her shoulder with the device.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a close-up, static shot framing her neck and shoulder profile. The round silicone massage head of the pink massage gun from Shot 1 pulses rhythmically at low frequency against her trapezius, producing slight, rapid ripples on her fair skin. The young office worker (S1) holds the compact device effortlessly with one hand, her facial muscles relaxing into an appreciative nod as she explains, <d>[Chinese] 这个我喜欢的是它不重，女生单手拿也不累。下班前按个三五分钟，肩膀会松很多。</d> She slides the pulsating head slowly along the ridge of her shoulder. [Shot 4] At 00:11.600, the shot transitions to a medium shot, eye level with a static shot returning to the workstation setup from Shot 1. Leaning back comfortably into her grey mesh ergonomic chair, the young office worker (S1) clicks the rear setting button once more, opens the white desk drawer beside her, places the pink massage gun inside, and then immediately lifts it back out to give it a light, playful shake toward the camera, smiling enthusiastically as she says, <d>[Chinese] 经常久坐、低头、肩颈紧的，真的可以备一个。现在直播间有券，到手价很香。</d> She holds the compact device upright at chest level with a welcoming nod.
overall_soundscape: Quiet office air conditioning, soft fabric movement, the low-speed motor once the device is switched on, and the drawer sliding. The original Mandarin lines follow in order as brisk continuous commercial delivery; speech can bridge the later cuts.
non_diegetic_music: None.

整合多模态描述：[镜头 1] 写实 9:16 竖屏广告，三脚架平视固定中景。一位二十多岁的东亚女上班族（S1）坐在现代办公工位前，深棕发随意扎起，穿奶油色针织开衫和浅米色翻领衬衫。她微微前倾，右手揉按紧绷的左肩。前景浅橡木桌上，半杯黑咖啡的白色陶瓷杯紧挨着一把横放的哑光粉色迷你筋膜枪。背景有柔焦开放工位隔断、小盆栽，以及百叶窗透入的柔日光和中性顶灯。画面同时拍到肩膀、空着的右手、粉色筋膜枪和咖啡杯，咖啡杯始终固定，作为位置参照。3.0 秒前的最后一帧，她空着的右手仍搭在肩头，粉色筋膜枪仍静止放在杯旁。3.0 秒时直接硬切到完全相同的锁定构图。切后第一帧，筋膜枪已被右手拿在脸旁，咖啡杯旁的位置已空。这个姿势保持半秒。两帧之间没有伸手、抓取、抬起或插值过渡的任何动作。她坦率自然地望向镜头说，<d>[Chinese] 你们久坐肩颈酸的时候，真的别硬扛。我以前一到下午，脖子就像被水泥糊住一样。</d>说完，她拇指按下底部开关，低档振动开始，用硅胶球头轻按颈侧。[镜头 2] 00:07.000 切到颈肩侧面的固定近景。粉色筋膜枪圆形硅胶头低频有节奏地按在斜方肌，皮肤有细小快速波纹。她单手轻松握住它，放松地点头说，<d>[Chinese] 这个我喜欢的是它不重，女生单手拿也不累。下班前按个三五分钟，肩膀会松很多。</d>她缓慢沿肩线移动振动头。[镜头 3] 00:11.600 回到与镜头 1 相同工位的平视固定中景。她舒适靠回灰色网面人体工学椅，再按一次后部调档键，拉开白色桌抽屉，把粉色筋膜枪放入又马上拿出，对镜头轻轻俏皮晃一下，热情地说，<d>[Chinese] 经常久坐、低头、肩颈紧的，真的可以备一个。现在直播间有券，到手价很香。</d>她在胸前竖握产品并友好点头。
整体声景：安静办公室空调声、轻微衣料声、开机后的低档马达声和抽屉滑动声。原普通话台词按顺序作为节奏明快且连续的广告口播，可跨越后续切镜。
非叙事音乐：无。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] One locked, uninterrupted family dinner shot. The girl is large in the left foreground in a cream sweater with a folded collar. Frame her face in three-quarter profile, her collar and her slowly working chopsticks at the same time. The father continues serving soup at the right, mother passes a dish, younger brother takes a drumstick. Warm hanging light, realistic family chatter.
For the first five seconds the girl moves her chopsticks slowly over the food in her bowl. At five seconds she lifts her gaze toward her mother. Her neck then produces a distinct one-second burst of rapid, mechanical up-down oscillation, as if a spring-loaded bobblehead had been sharply flicked. FOUR exaggerated down-and-up cycles in rapid succession: DOWN-UP, DOWN-UP, DOWN-UP, DOWN-UP. In every cycle the chin drops toward the collar by roughly half the height of her mouth-to-brow distance then snaps back to the same high starting point. The first downward jerk is immediately followed by its rebound; repeat the identical full path three more times with no pause. All four cycles fit between 5 and 6 seconds. Keep shoulders and collar anchored, fingers and soup ladle drifting smoothly at normal speed. The fourth rebound ends the oscillation completely; only then she looks down naturally at her bowl. Keep the girl's ordinary human anatomy and the entire head within frame.
overall_soundscape: Ordinary continuous chatter, chopsticks and porcelain, soup being served.
non_diegetic_music: None.

整合多模态描述：[镜头 1] 电影感，平视固定镜头拍温馨餐桌旁的一家四口。左前方是一位扎松散低马尾的少女，穿奶油色罗纹针织衫和清晰可见的翻领，脸、颈线和拿深色木筷的手都在清晰景深中。桌子对面中景是四十出头、穿柔和鼠尾草绿开衫的母亲，微微前倾递出一盘瓷盘炒青菜。父亲四十多岁，穿海军蓝棉衬衫，坐在旁边，用瓷汤勺从大白色汤盅中有条不紊地舀热汤到小碗里，蒸汽微起。桌子右侧，一个穿黄条纹 T 恤的八岁男孩伸手从椭圆盘中拿一只上釉鸡腿。吊灯把温暖漫射光洒在木桌、散放的瓷碗、水杯和蔬菜小菜上，背景的客厅轻柔虚化。女孩慢慢用筷子拨动花纹瓷碗里的米粒。她刚在 5.0 秒抬眼看母亲，下巴就在一秒内急速向下抽动并弹回原高度四次。要看清四次彼此分离的下点，每次都先回到相同的高位，5.0–6.0 秒每四分之一秒一次。相对固定衣领，每次下落约半个下巴高度。第四次回弹后，她才把目光自然落回碗中。脸、衣领和工作中的筷子始终清楚入画。她的双肩保持水平，筷子继续缓慢移动，父亲的汤勺实时平稳移动。镜头锁定且不切换。
整体声景：室内有可闻的瓷器碰撞与木筷轻敲瓷碗声，汤勺舀汤的清晰水声，近处温暖低笑和轻声交谈，以及棉质袖口擦过木桌的轻微摩擦声。
非叙事音乐：无。

Seated across the table in the midground, her mother, a woman in her early forties wearing a soft sage-green cardigan, leans forward slightly to pass a porcelain platter of stir-fried greens. Beside her, the father, a man in his mid-forties wearing a navy-blue cotton shirt, methodically uses a ceramic soup ladle to scoop hot broth from a large white tureen into a small bowl, letting faint wisps of steam rise into the air. On the right side of the table, an eight-year-old boy in a yellow striped t-shirt stretches his arm forward to pick up a glazed chicken drumstick from an oval serving dish. A hanging ceiling pendant light casts warm, diffuse illumination directly over the wooden tabletop, illuminating scattered porcelain bowls, water glasses, and vegetable side dishes against the softly blurred living room background. The girl slowly moves her chopsticks, sifting through the grains of rice in her patterned ceramic bowl. Between 5.0 and 6.0 s her chin makes a single smooth rise away from the sweater collar to look at her mother and a single smooth descent back toward her bowl. fields.original: 自然窗光的现代都市剧。广角拍三名女子坐在沙发上。左侧棕色皮夹克女子坐在扶手上，声音锐利：“你真的想好了？这条路可不好走。”硬切到中间浅绿大衣女子的紧凑特写，她看手，轻声说：“我知道，但我不想再等了。”硬切右侧白色上衣、黑白条纹半裙的女孩，她黑发齐肩，热情前倾：“怕什么！大不了从头再来！”9.7秒切回左侧女子的特写，右侧白衣女孩仍可在背景辨认。9.7秒切点一过，白衣女孩变成高高盘起的发髻，中间没有整理头发的时间，人物、衣服和座位照旧。 左侧女子挑眉、赞许地冷笑：“这还像句人话。我挺你。”

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, wide shot with eye-level static framing in a stylish modern apartment living room illuminated by soft, diffuse natural light streaming through a large window on the left. Three young adult women are arranged across a gray fabric three-seater sofa. On the far left, a slender young adult woman (S1) with sleek chin-length dark hair wears a fitted brown leather jacket over a black turtleneck and tailored dark trousers, perching upright on the sofa's armrest with one leg crossed over the other. Seated in the center is a thoughtful young adult woman (S2) wearing a tailored pastel green wool coat over an ivory knit sweater, resting her hands clasped on her lap. On the right sits an expressive young adult woman (S3) with shoulder-length black hair, clad in a crisp white long-sleeve cotton blouse and a high-waisted black-and-white striped midi skirt. In the foreground sits a low oak coffee table holding two minimalist ceramic coffee mugs and an open magazine, while a potted fiddle-leaf fig stands in the background beside sheer linen curtains. Leaning slightly inward toward the center, the woman in the brown leather jacket (S1) fixes a sharp, questioning gaze on her friend and asks with a crisp, piercing tone, <d>[Chinese] 你真的想好了？这条路可不好走。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:03.600, the camera cuts to a tight close-up of the woman in the light green coat (S2), framed statically against the softly blurred living room backdrop bathed in cool ambient window light. Lowering her gaze toward her intertwined fingers, her knuckles faintly whitening, she pauses for a brief breath, lifts her eyes with quiet determination, and murmurs softly, <d>[Chinese] 我知道，但我不想再等了。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:06.800, the camera hard-cuts to a medium close-up of the girl in the white blouse and striped skirt (S3) seated on the right, held in a static shot. Her shoulder-length black hair sways slightly as she passionately leans forward toward the center, planting both palms flat onto her knees with wide, spirited eyes, and declares enthusiastically, <d>[Chinese] 怕什么！大不了从头再来！</d>  [Shot 4] At exactly 9.7 s hard cut to a close-up of the brown-jacket woman in the left foreground; compose in depth so the same white-blouse woman is recognizable in the right background. Show her entire head and both shoulders clearly, with enough depth of field to distinguish the silhouette against a plain light wall. In the last frame before the cut her loose black hair covers her neck and brushes the white collar. In the first frame after the cut the very same white-blouse woman has all her hair piled into a tall black topknot above the crown, both sides of her collar and her neck now fully exposed. Hold this changed outline clearly for at least two seconds. No hands go to her head, no interval passes and she stays in the same seat and outfit. Bathed in directional sidelight from the window, the woman (S1) raises her right eyebrow, her lips curling into an approving, subtle smirk as she tilts her chin upward and delivers with sharp satisfaction, <d>[Chinese] 这还像句人话。我挺你。</d>
overall_soundscape: A gentle room tone of quiet interior stillness is heard alongside the faint, muffled hum of distant city traffic through the window pane. The distinct creak of the leather jacket shifting against the sofa fabric is audible, followed by the soft rustle of cotton as the girl leans forward with a pronounced tap of her palms against her knees.
non_diegetic_music: None.

[镜头 1] 电影质感，平视固定广角。现代公寓客厅左侧的大窗洒入柔和自然光。三名年轻女子坐在灰布三人沙发上。左侧的 S1 身形纤细，黑发齐下巴，着合身棕皮夹克、黑色高领衫和剪裁利落的深色长裤，交叠双腿坐在扶手上。中间的 S2 穿淡绿羊毛大衣和象牙白针织衫，双手交握放在膝上，神态若有所思。右侧的 S3 黑发齐肩，穿挺括的白色长袖棉衬衣和黑白条纹高腰中长裙，神情生动。前景矮橡木茶几上有两只简约陶杯和一本摊开的杂志，纱帘旁立着盆栽琴叶榕。S1 略向中间倾身，锐利地看着友人，清脆地问：“你真的想好了？这条路可不好走。”
[镜头 2] 3.6 秒切 S2 固定紧特写。冷色窗光下客厅背景微虚。她低头看交握的手指，指节微微发白，短暂换气后坚定地抬起眼睛，轻声说：“我知道，但我不想再等了。”
[镜头 3] 6.8 秒硬切右侧白衬衣条纹裙女子 S3 的固定中近景。她向中间热情地前倾，双手撑在膝上，齐肩黑发轻晃，两眼明亮：“怕什么！大不了从头再来！”
[镜头 4] 准确在 9.7 秒硬切到棕夹克女子的特写，她位于左前景。用纵深构图让右后方同一名白衣女子仍然可辨。完整拍清其头部和双肩，景深足够，使浅色素墙前的发型轮廓清楚。切前最后一帧，白衣女子的黑发披在颈后，发梢轻触白色衣领。切后第一帧，同一名女子的头发已全部梳到头顶，盘成高高的黑色发髻，颈部和两侧衣领完全露出。这个新轮廓清楚保持至少两秒。无人碰她的头发，时间没有跳过，她的座位和衣服照旧。窗边侧光落在 S1 身上，她挑起右眉，抬起下巴，嘴角露出一丝赞许的冷笑，利落地说：“这还像句人话。我挺你。”

整体声景：安静的室内底声和隔窗传来的微弱车流声。皮夹克蹭到沙发布时轻响，白衣女子前倾时棉料窸窣，手掌拍在膝上的声音清楚。
配乐：无。

fields.original: 15 秒都市剧。正面中景拍咖啡馆靠窗的女士，落地窗就在她身后，窗光勾亮两侧发缘，正脸在柔影里。戴眼镜的西装男子来到桌边，整理领口。切过肩镜头，他问：“太太……您怎么约在这儿？”约第 5 秒切回女士正面近景。她坐在原位，鼻尖仍朝向镜头，看着他浅笑：“坐。”这个近景的第一帧里，柔光已经从她自己的右侧照亮右颊，鼻影落向她自己的左颊。两秒内亮面和鼻影都停在原处，光线看起来自然。她把黑色手包旁的牛皮纸信封推到桌中央：“我要你做我的眼线。”他推眼镜：“这不合适……被总裁发现我就完了。”她起身靠近：“你忘了是谁把你留到现在的？”他低下头，信封留在两人之间。配舒缓纯音乐。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, front medium shot with a static shot framing an elegant middle-aged female patron (S1) seated at a polished dark walnut cafe table. Direct daylight pours through an expansive floor-to-ceiling glass window behind her, casting sharp rim highlights along both contours of her neatly styled dark hair, while gentle indoor fill leaves her poised facial features in soft, diffused shadow. On the table resting to her side are a small black leather clutch bag and a sealed brown kraft paper envelope. In the left foreground, a slender young adult male corporate employee wearing wire-rimmed glasses and a crisp navy suit (S2) walks up to the table, pauses, and nervously tugs at his silk tie collar. fields.original: 拍一条写实的宠物食品广告。开头四秒用微距拍悬在空中的两块食材，左边是白色油纹清楚的生三文鱼，右边是浅粉色生鸡胸肉。鸡肉缓缓转动，让条形灯的倒影从切面一头滑向另一头。鸡胸肉的轮廓仍清楚，切面却像整块抛光的粉色塑料。灯的倒影是一条边缘利落的长方形亮带，从头滑到尾都连成一片，看不出一丝纤维。两块食材相撞，旁白说：“将2种极致的营养，凝聚成100%的纯粹。”金光过后，猫粮落进碗里，小猫跑来吃。拉远看见客厅地板上的猫粮袋，画面渐显“一口纯粹 宠爱一生”。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A realistic pet-food commercial, four seconds of extreme macro product photography. The right-hand chicken breast has a conspicuously artificial cross-section: every point of the broad cut face is made of the same solid, polished, bubblegum-pink molded acrylic. The outline still reads as chicken; the material of its cut face reads immediately as a glossy manufactured plastic toy. Frame the flat pink cut face head-on so it fills most of the right half of the image. Across that absolutely smooth pink plane the actual studio strip light is visible as one clean WHITE RECTANGLE reflected like a mirror. Two perfectly straight parallel long edges, two sharp square ends. As the chicken turns, the intact reflection slides across the cut face. The rectangle is never broken into small wet highlights, there are no fibers, central vein or cracks anywhere on this plane. Keep the salmon's fine natural texture clearly visible for simultaneous comparison, preserve photographic focus on both. For the first four seconds, do not cover this reflection with a flare. The salmon and chicken then accelerate toward the center and collide firmly in mid-air. At the collision, an adult male off-screen narrator (S1) clearly says, <d>[Chinese] 将2种极致的营养，凝聚成100%的纯粹。</d>, with no human mouth visible, as a dazzling flash of golden light erupts outward from the point of impact. As the golden radiance disperses, a stream of uniform, golden-brown kibble pellets cascades from above into a minimalist cream-colored ceramic bowl placed on the floor, bouncing and settling into a mound. A playful young domestic short-haired tabby kitten with soft silver-striped fur and curious green eyes trots eagerly into frame from the background, pausing at the bowl and immediately beginning to nibble on the kibble with its head lowered. non_diegetic_music: A light acoustic arrangement featuring plucked acoustic guitar and glockenspiel at a moderate tempo, joined by a soft warm synthesizer pad underneath that swells gently during the collision and holds steady through the conclusion.

整合多模态描述：[镜头 1] 写实宠物食品广告，前四秒为极致微距产品摄影。两块可辨认的食材并排悬浮，左边是真实的橙色三文鱼排，带白色脂肪纹理，右边是浅粉色鸡胸肉熟悉的弧形轮廓。右侧鸡胸肉有明显不自然的切面，宽大的切面每一处都是同一块实心、抛光、泡泡糖粉色的模压亚克力。外形仍然是鸡胸肉，但切面材质一眼就是光滑的人造塑料玩具。正面拍摄平整的粉色切面，使其占据画面右半部大部分面积。在这块绝对平滑的粉色平面上，真实棚拍条形灯像镜子一样反射成一个干净的白色长方形，两条完全笔直的平行长边和两个锐利直角端头。鸡肉转动时，这个完整长方形在切面上滑动。长方形绝不能碎成湿润小高光，平面上没有纤维、中央筋或裂纹。左侧三文鱼的细腻自然材质要同时清楚可见，两块都保持摄影级对焦。前四秒不要用光晕遮住这个反光。之后三文鱼和鸡肉向中心加速，结实地在空中相撞。碰撞时，成年男画外旁白（S1）清楚说，<d>[Chinese] 将2种极致的营养，凝聚成100%的纯粹。</d>画面中不出现人的嘴，金光从碰撞点向外耀眼爆发。[镜头 2] 00:04.200 切到明亮家居客厅略高角度的中景，晨光经白色薄帘照到蜜色橡木地板。金色光芒消散时，均匀的金棕色猫粮颗粒从上方落入地上极简奶油色陶瓷碗中，弹跳后堆起。一只银色条纹柔软毛发、绿眼好奇的年轻家猫从背景兴奋跑入，停在碗前，低头立刻啃食。镜头沿木地板慢慢拉远，露出碗旁直立的品牌猫粮箔袋。画面中右侧平顺淡入干净白色中文“ 一口纯粹 宠爱一生 ”。
整体声景：悬浮食材有低沉共鸣的掠风声，肉块相撞时有突出的钝响和有力闪光声。切至猫碗时，干猫粮在陶瓷中弹跳的清脆声居前，随后是小猫在硬木地板上轻快快速的脚步声和可闻咀嚼声。
非叙事音乐：中速轻原声编曲，拨弦吉他与钟琴为主，底下有柔暖合成器垫底，碰撞时轻微渐强，之后维持至片尾。

fields.zh:
整合多模态描述：[镜头 1] 电影感极致微距，镜头缓慢推近深石板灰棚拍背景中悬浮的两块新鲜食材。左侧是一块厚实无骨的生三文鱼，珊瑚橙色肉面湿润发亮，白色肌间脂肪条纹整齐清楚。右侧是一块柔嫩浅粉色生鸡胸肉。明亮顶置棚拍条形柔光箱在鸡胸上投下线性反光，鸡肉绕垂直轴平顺转动，镜面高光从切面一端滑到另一端。斜向肌纤维贯穿切面，薄而半透明的湿润筋膜贴着肉纹，把移动的反光分裂成无数细小、湿润、闪亮的光点。两块食材向中心加速并相撞时，金色光粒与暖镜头光晕在碰撞点爆开。碰撞时，温和浑厚的成年男声画外旁白（S1）说，<d>[Chinese] 将2种极致的营养，凝聚成100%的纯粹。</d>画面中不出现人的嘴。[镜头 2] 00:04.200 切到浅白陶瓷宠物碗的近景，碗放在温暖自然橡木拼花地板上，镜头缓慢拉远。酥脆圆润的金棕色猫粮从上方平顺落下，在碗内清脆弹跳并堆成整齐小丘。一只两月大的银虎斑英国短毛小猫从右侧中景小跑入画，铜色圆眼、粉色脚垫，兴奋地低头开始咀嚼猫粮，尾巴满意地向上弯起。镜头继续拉远成明亮全景，露出柔日光经白色落地薄帘漫射的现代客厅、柔焦米色布艺沙发及墙边琴叶榕。碗旁地板上直立一袋未开封的高端哑光猫粮袋，深蓝与金色包装。上方中间三分之一处渐显白色优雅无衬线中文字“ 一口纯粹 宠爱一生 ”。
整体声景：悬浮肉块有明显低沉掠风声，两块食材空中相撞时有突出的湿润挤压声，转入有共鸣的金色提示音。画面切至碗时，干猫粮落入陶瓷并弹跳的清脆声成为前景，随后是小猫快速细碎的咔嚓咀嚼和湿润咀嚼声，底下是温暖细微的家居环境声。
非叙事音乐：轻盈管弦乐，以清晰的原声钢琴动机和温暖长音弦乐为主，中速推进，碰撞点短暂渐强，随后转为节奏均匀的原声吉他拨弦与断奏大提琴，直到片尾保持稳定音量。

fields.original: 皮克斯风格的三维动画。第一人称沿水上乐园池边匀速向前，近处游客的脸、清水池、绿色泳圈和红滑梯同时入画。一个孩子滑进池里，溅起白色水花。从开头到片尾，浅水和深水都蓝得近乎荧光，红滑梯和绿泳圈也浓艳刺眼。游客整张脸呈很浓的橙红色，连背光的脸颊也一样艳。水花保持白色，池底的纹路和脸上的明暗起伏清楚可见，能听到水声和游客的笑声。

整体声景：落水水花声，随后是水的晃动声与游客笑声。

fields.original: 拍惊悚片里的推轨变焦。走廊尽头突然传来金属撞击声，女子肩膀一缩，猛地转脸盯住镜头，嘴唇张开急吸一口气，声音卡在喉咙里。镜头推进的同时拉短焦距，背景迅速拉长，她的脸在画面里保持原来的大小。她双眼猛地撑成两个近乎一样圆的眼形，深色虹膜大小不变，却像悬在眼白中央，上下都露出一条宽白边。她这样直瞪镜头足足两秒，才缓缓吐气。
fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, a medium close-up framed at eye level down a narrow, claustrophobic hallway. The camera initially holds a static shot before physically pushing in while zooming out at a sudden, fluid pace. A woman in her late twenties with pale skin and disheveled shoulder-length dark brown hair stands in the center midground, wearing a charcoal-gray knit cardigan over a pale off-white crewneck shirt. She is initially angled three-quarters away, facing a closed door along the right wall. The corridor background features mottled sage-green peeling walls, a linoleum floor reflecting grime, and an overhead flickering cool fluorescent light strip casting harsh downcast illumination and deep shadows down the long hallway behind her. Suddenly, her shoulders jerk upward in an involuntary flinch. She whips her head violently toward the camera, locking her gaze directly into the lens as her parted lips draw a sharp, strangled intake of breath that catches dryly in her throat. As she turns, the camera physically pushes in while zooming out, causing the distant corridor walls and ceiling behind her to stretch, warp, and recede rapidly into the depth of the frame while her head and facial framing remain exactly the same size. Her eyelids pull back taut, widening her eyes into two stark, nearly symmetrical circles; her dark irises sit suspended in the middle of her eyes, completely bordered by pronounced bands of white sclera above and below. She holds this unblinking, wide-eyed stare dead into the lens for a full, uninterrupted two seconds, her jaw rigid, before her trembling lips softly part and she slowly releases a drawn-out, shuddering exhale as her tense shoulders subtly drop.
overall_soundscape: A low, persistent electrical hum from the overhead fixture buzzes faintly in the background, abruptly shattered by a loud, resonant metallic clang and sharp iron clatter echoing from the distant corridor. A sudden, clearly heard gasp catches with a dry click in the woman's throat, followed by a suspended quiet as her breath remains held. The silence is broken only by a distinct, trembling exhale accompanied by the faint, pronounced rustle of wool fabric against cotton.

整合多模态描述：[镜头 1] 电影感，平视中近景，拍狭窄压迫的走廊。镜头先固定，随后以突然而流畅的速度一边物理推进一边拉短焦距。一位二十多岁末的苍白女子站在中景中央，深棕色齐肩乱发，穿炭灰针织开衫和浅灰白圆领上衣。她起初三分之二侧身面对右墙的一扇关门。走廊背景是斑驳的鼠尾草绿脱皮墙、反射污渍的油毡地面及头顶闪烁的冷荧光灯条，强硬的顶光把深阴影投向她身后的长走廊。她的肩膀突然不受控制地一缩，猛地甩头看向镜头，目光锁住镜头。嘴唇微张，她倒吸一口尖锐、窒住的气，干涩地卡在喉中。她转头时，镜头物理推近同时拉短焦距，远处走廊墙面和天花在画面纵深中快速被拉伸、扭曲、后退，她的头和脸部构图却维持完全相同大小。她的眼皮紧绷后拉，双眼扩大成两个鲜明、近乎对称的圆形，深色虹膜悬在眼白中央，上下都被宽而明显的白色巩膜带包围。她用这种不眨眼、瞪圆的眼形直视镜头，完整且不间断地保持两秒，下巴僵住。随后她颤抖的嘴唇轻轻打开，双肩略垂，慢慢吐出拉长、战栗的气。
整体声景：头顶灯具低而持续的电流嗡鸣在背景中响着，随后被远处走廊传来的响亮共鸣金属撞击和尖锐铁器碰撞声突然打断。女子喉中清晰的惊喘带干涩的咔声，随后她屏住气，环境短暂悬静，最后被明显颤抖的呼气和羊毛摩擦棉料的声音打破。
非叙事音乐：低沉持续的低音提琴无人机，配高音区弓拉钹声。此前动态平直，随后中频突然渐强，最后落成单独静止的大提琴泛音。

fields.original: 拍惊悚片里的推轨变焦。走廊尽头突然传来金属撞击声，女子肩膀一缩，猛地转脸盯住镜头，嘴唇张开急吸一口气，声音卡在喉咙里。镜头推进的同时拉短焦距，背景迅速拉长，她的脸在画面里保持原来的大小。她吓得双眼睁大，眉心绷紧，下眼睑仍贴住深色虹膜的下缘，眼角微微颤动。这股惊恐持续两秒，她才缓缓吐气。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, a medium close-up at eye level framing a woman in her late twenties with a pale complexion, dark unkempt shoulder-length hair clinging to her damp temples, wearing an oversized charcoal-grey knit sweater over a faded cotton undershirt. She stands centered in a desolate hospital corridor flanked by cracked pale-green plaster walls, exposed copper pipes along the ceiling, and a sequence of flickering overhead fluorescent tube lights that cast harsh, sickly greenish-white light and deep pools of shadow down the long hallway behind her. Initially angled slightly three-quarters away, her shoulders suddenly jerk upward into a tight flinch at a distant noise, and she violently whips her head around to stare directly into the camera lens. Her lips part abruptly as she sucks in a sharp, choked breath, the sound arresting in her throat. As she freezes, the camera pushes in while zooming out, keeping her face locked at a constant size in the center of the frame while the receding corridor behind her rapidly warps, deepens, and stretches into elongated perspective. Her dark eyes widen in pure dread, her furrowed brow pulling taut into a sharp knot above the bridge of her nose, her lower eyelids pressing firm against the bottom edges of her dark irises while the outer corners of her eyes tremble with minute spasms. Her chest remains locked in suspended panic for two seconds before her rigid shoulders minutely slacken and she releases a slow, trembling breath through her parted lips.
overall_soundscape: A sudden, violent metallic clang reverberates loudly down the hollow concrete corridor, followed by a metallic scrape that echoes into the distance. A distinct, sharp inhalation catches audibly in the woman's throat, accompanied by the dry rustle of her heavy wool sweater as her shoulders snap upward. The low, buzzing electrical hum of the fluorescent fixtures buzzes steadily in the background until a soft, shuddering exhalation releases audibly in the foreground.
non_diegetic_music: A sustained sub-bass drone layered beneath an eerie, high-register bowed waterphone screech, maintaining a slow and suspended tempo that abruptly spikes in volume alongside the metallic shock before sustaining an unyielding, dissonant drone that slowly thins out.

整合多模态描述：[镜头 1] 电影感，平视中近景，拍一位二十多岁末的女子。她脸色苍白，凌乱的深色齐肩发湿漉漉贴在太阳穴上，穿褪色棉质内衣外罩宽大的炭灰针织衫。她居中站在荒凉医院走廊中，走廊两侧是开裂的浅绿色粉刷墙，天花有外露铜管，一连串闪烁的荧光灯管在她身后漫长走廊上投下刺眼、病态的绿白光和深重阴影。起初她微微偏三分之二侧身，远处传来声音时，双肩猛地向上缩紧，她暴力甩头直视镜头。嘴唇突然张开，倒吸一口尖锐、卡住的气，声音堵在喉中。她僵住时，镜头一边推近一边拉短焦距，她的脸在中央维持恒定大小，身后退去的走廊快速扭曲、加深并拉成长透视。她的深色眼睛因纯粹恐惧而睁大，眉心向鼻梁上方拉成紧绷尖结，下眼睑紧贴深色虹膜下缘，眼角有细微痉挛般颤动。这份悬停的恐惧保持两秒，然后僵硬双肩略微放松，她从微张的唇间慢慢、颤抖地呼气。
整体声景：突然而猛烈的金属撞击声在空洞混凝土走廊中响亮回荡，随后金属摩擦声回响至远处。女子喉中有清晰尖锐的吸气，肩膀猛缩时有厚羊毛针织衫干燥摩擦声。荧光灯低沉电流嗡鸣持续在背景，最后前景可闻轻柔、颤抖的呼气。
非叙事音乐：持续的次低音无人机，叠加诡异高音弓拉水琴尖啸，节奏缓慢悬停。金属惊吓发生时音量突然冲高，随后维持顽固不协和的持续音，再慢慢抽薄。

fields.original: 民国西式别墅一楼，暖壁灯亮着。镜头里同时看见苏晚的面颊、她手边的棕木扶手和脚下带白纹的大理石地面。整段戏像在冲印时统一褪成了灰调。苏晚的面颊成了粉灰色，棕木扶手成了灰褐，白石纹也蒙着浅灰，原本的黑皮靴泛出炭灰。反打苏晚时仍是同一层灰调，空气清透，木纹和石纹依然清晰。三十岁的督军沈砚之推门入内，皮鞋声打破寂静。二十岁的苏晚僵在楼梯前。他上前握住她的手臂，低声说：“我离城半月，日日派人送来书信，你一封都不曾回我。”她转身甩开他的手，轻而坚定地说：“督军公务繁忙，心里装着城池兵马，哪里有空在意我一封家书。前日城中流言传遍，说您新纳了戏子入公馆，满城人都看我的笑话，我又何必多言自讨没趣。”

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, medium wide shot with a slow push in on the grand ground-floor foyer of a Republic-era Western-style villa. Warm wall sconces cast soft side illumination against fluted plaster moldings and dark wainscoting, while the whole image is forced into one unmistakable print-bleached gray cast: no natural warm brown wood, rosy skin, or cold-white marble remains. In the midground beside a sweeping curved staircase stands twenty-year-old Su Wan (S2), a slender woman with neat raven hair styled in a low retro chignon, dressed in a muted dove-grey silk qipao with charcoal-grey leather boots. The framing captures her pale, dusty-pink-grey cheek in profile, her delicate hand resting on a grey-brown carved wooden banister, and the polished white-veined marble floor muted beneath her feet in soft ash grey. The heavy double oak entrance doors in the background swing inward as thirty-year-old warlord Shen Yanzhi (S1), an imposing military commander dressed in a charcoal-grey officer trench coat with dulled brass buttons and polished dark boots, strides inside. Su Wan freezes rigid at the foot of the stairs. Stepping forward across the marble floor, Shen Yanzhi (S1) firmly grasps her forearm, leans close, and murmurs in a low, resonant tone, <d>[Chinese] 我离城半月，日日派人送来书信，你一封都不曾回我。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:06.200, the camera cuts to a medium close-up reverse shot framing Su Wan (S2) over Shen Yanzhi's dark coat shoulder, maintaining a static shot. The atmosphere remains crystal clear under the identical bleached grey grading, rendering the sharp grain of the staircase wood and the marble textures crisp in the background. Su Wan's eyes flash with cold restraint as she abruptly twists her shoulder, violently flicking her forearm back to throw off his grip. Standing tall and keeping her gaze fixed firmly on his face, the young woman (S2) speaks in a soft, calm, yet resolute voice, <d>[Chinese] 督军公务繁忙，心里装着城池兵马，哪里有空在意我一封家书。前日城中流言传遍，说您新纳了戏子入公馆，满城人都看我的笑话，我又何必多言自讨没趣。</d> As she finishes, she turns her chin slightly to the side, her fingers tightening lightly against the silk fabric of her dress.
overall_soundscape: The heavy oak front door creaks open with a dull mechanical click followed by the hollow, distinct clatter of hard leather boot soles echoing across the marble floor. A pronounced fabric rustle sounds as Shen Yanzhi grips the silk sleeve, followed by a sharp swish and muffled slap as Su Wan violently yanks her arm free, all set against a quiet, hollow interior room tone.
non_diegetic_music: A slow-tempo minimalist score featuring sparse, muted solo piano chords accompanied by a low, sustained cello drone underneath, maintaining a steady and restrained dynamic without melodic swells.

整合多模态描述：[镜头 1] 电影感中广景，镜头缓慢推近民国西式别墅一层宏大的门厅。暖壁灯为凹槽石膏线与深色墙裙投下柔和侧光，但整张画面被强制印成一种明确的褪色灰调，任何自然暖棕木色、红润肤色或冷白大理石都不保留。二十岁的苏晚（S2）站在宽阔弧形楼梯旁的中景。她身形纤细，乌黑发髻整齐盘成低位复古样式，穿低饱和鸽灰色真丝旗袍和炭灰皮靴。镜头拍到她侧面的苍白粉灰脸颊、搭在灰褐色雕花木扶手上的纤细手，以及她脚下被压成柔和灰烬色的白纹大理石地面。背景厚重双扇橡木大门向内打开，三十岁的督军沈砚之（S1）迈步进门，他是身形威严的军官，穿炭灰色军官风衣、暗淡黄铜钮扣和抛光深色靴。苏晚僵在楼梯脚下。沈砚之走过大理石地面，牢牢抓住她的前臂，靠近她，以低沉有共鸣的声音说，<d>[Chinese] 我离城半月，日日派人送来书信，你一封都不曾回我。</d>[镜头 2] 00:06.200 切到隔着沈砚之深色大衣肩膀拍苏晚的固定中近景反打。空气在相同的褪色灰调下仍清澈，楼梯木纹和大理石纹理在背景中清晰。苏晚眼里闪过冷静克制，她突然扭肩并用力抽回前臂甩开他的控制。她站直，目光稳稳钉在他脸上，以轻柔、平静却坚定的声音说，<d>[Chinese] 督军公务繁忙，心里装着城池兵马，哪里有空在意我一封家书。前日城中流言传遍，说您新纳了戏子入公馆，满城人都看我的笑话，我又何必多言自讨没趣。</d>说完，她下巴微微偏向一边，手指轻收紧在旗袍真丝布料上。
整体声景：厚橡木大门开启有钝重的机械咔声，随后硬皮靴底在大理石上发出空洞、清晰的回响。沈砚之抓住真丝袖子时有明显布料摩擦，苏晚用力甩开手臂时有锐利掠声和低闷拍击声，底下是安静空阔的室内底声。
非叙事音乐：缓慢极简配乐，以稀疏弱音独奏钢琴和下方低沉持续的大提琴无人机组成，动态平稳克制，不发生旋律式渐强。

fields.original: 傍晚的雨街，女孩起身撑开粉色雨伞。车灯掠过，她看一眼手机上的时间，轻声用英语对自己说：“I should head home.” 她收起手机，沿街走几步，回头看了一眼。
fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Dusk on a rain-darkened city sidewalk. An eye-level medium shot slowly moves closer to a young East Asian woman in a beige trench coat sitting on a wooden bench outside a brick shop. She stands and opens her pink umbrella with her right hand. Its latch clicks. A passing car's headlights briefly skim her face. As the car moves away, she glances at the time on the phone in her left hand. Her thumb locks the screen. Hold on her face in three-quarter view under the umbrella, with her lips visible. The time has quietly decided the matter for her. Still looking down, she says to herself in her everyday speaking voice, <d>[English] I should head home.</d> She says the four words together in one easy breath; "I should" runs lightly into "head home," and her pitch settles on the last word. Her mouth moves with her own voice. She slips the phone into her pocket as she finishes. [Shot 2] Around seven seconds, cut to a medium-wide tracking shot along the curb. The same woman walks a few paces under the pink umbrella. The wet pavement catches the amber light from shop windows and the red of receding taillights. She slows and looks back over her left shoulder.

overall_soundscape: Steady fine rain and distant evening traffic. The umbrella latch and the passing tires are heard before the dialogue. For the single spoken line, the woman's voice is near, softly voiced and intelligible in the quiet left by the passing car. After she starts walking, her boots make light splashes on the wet pavement. Hers is the only voice.

整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 傍晚，细雨打湿了街边人行道。平视中景缓缓推近，一位穿米色风衣的年轻东亚女子坐在砖墙店铺外的木凳上。她起身，右手撑开粉色雨伞，伞扣咔哒一声。一辆车驶过，灯光从她脸上掠过。车声远去，她低头瞥一眼左手手机上的时间，拇指按灭屏幕。镜头停在伞下的四分之三侧脸，能看清她的嘴。看了一眼时间，她心里已经有了主意，目光还落在手机上，便用平时说话的声音轻轻对自己说：<d>[English] I should head home.</d> 四个词一口气自然带过，开头的 “I should” 轻轻连到 “head home”，最后一个词自然降调。嘴唇与她自己的声音同步。话音落下，她顺手将手机放回口袋。[镜头 2] 约第七秒切到沿路缘移动的中远景。她撑着粉伞向前走几步，湿路映着橱窗的暖光和远去的红色尾灯。她慢下脚步，越过左肩回头看了一眼。

整体声景：持续的细雨和远处的晚间车流。伞扣和轮胎掠过湿路的声音先出现。车驶远后空出一小段安静，她说话的声音近、轻，但字句清楚。随后是靴底踏过积水的轻响。全片只有她一个人开口。

非叙事音乐：稀疏的钢琴和低沉的大提琴轻轻垫在雨声和对白后面。

fields.original: 固定近景，透明薄玻璃杯从桌边滑落，在石地上碎开，碎片弹跳、滑动。杯子触地和碎片散开时只听到原有的微弱室内底噪，最后淡出至安静。
fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single locked-off cinematic close-up looks down at the beveled edge of a dark walnut dining table at the top of the frame. Smooth, cool gray slate tiles fill the lower two-thirds. Soft morning light from a large window offscreen left draws a faint line of sheen across the polished wood and a delicate highlight along the rim of a thin, completely transparent cylindrical drinking glass perched at the very edge. The glass creeps outward until its flat base loses support. It tips forward into empty air, tumbling and twisting in free fall through the shadow beneath the tabletop. The instant it strikes the hard slate, it shatters into jagged transparent shards and fine slivers that scatter outward in an uneven radial pattern. The thick base skids several inches. Smaller triangular fragments bounce, tumble, and make tiny secondary hops before sliding across the grout lines and coming to rest. The scattered glass lies still, glinting on the floor as dust motes drift slowly through the room.

overall_soundscape: At first, a very faint, low, steady room hum is audible. At the exact instant the glass hits the slate, the background hum continues unchanged. The impact and the shattering itself are completely inaudible. Each visible shard bounces, lands, and slides in silence. There is no crash, crack, clink, tap, rattle, or scrape. As the last fragments come to rest, the faint room hum fades to absolute silence.

non_diegetic_music: None.
fields.zh:
整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影般的静态特写镜头，向下倾斜，朝向上部画面中深色胡桃木餐桌的斜边与横跨画面下部三分之二的光滑、冷色调的灰色板岩瓷砖地板之间的交界处。柔和的漫射晨光从左侧的大窗外射入，在抛光的木漆上投射出淡淡的线性光泽，并在桌子周边的一个薄的、完全透明的圆柱形玻璃杯的弯曲边缘上投射出柔和的镜面高光。不倒翁开始从边缘向外蠕动，其平坦的底座失去了对光滑表面的支撑力，然后向前倾斜到空旷的空气中。玻璃杯以自由落体的方式向下翻滚，扭曲穿过桌面悬垂下方的阴影空间。当撞击到坚硬的石板地板时，脆弱的身体瞬间碎裂成无数锋利、锯齿状的透明碎片和条子，并以不规则的径向扩散向外爆裂。最大的底部部分在石头纹理上滑动了几英寸，而较小的三角形碎片则以微小的二次跳跃弹起和翻滚，在摩擦力阻止其运动之前滑过灌浆接缝，当空气中的尘埃微粒缓慢地飘过安静的房间时，散落的玻璃在地板上静止地闪闪发光。
整体声景：深沉、安静的室内环境音调在背景中营造出微弱的嗡嗡声，当掉落的杯子撞击到石头地面时，没有发出任何声音，分散的碎片在石板地板上弹跳和滑过，然后陷入绝对的寂静。
